message: 青空と塔マニア

name: Synn
message: 「So busy, so busy.」

name: Paqy
message: 「My Lord Demon Lord. You're soundin' like the March Hare.」

name: Synn
message: 「What's that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...」
He's looking up at the tower again.
No, not the tower--he's looking way up into the sky.

name: Synn
message: 「What is he doing?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Lookin' at the tower, obviously.」

name: Synn
message: 「I can see that. Why is he looking up there?」

name: Paqy
message: 「He's gotta be a tower maniac. There's a maniac for everything, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's definitely not it. Besides, strictly speaking, it's not the tower--」

name: Paqy
message: 「I think it's best to leave him alone. We've got plenty on our plate too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, as the Student Council President, I can't just do that.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You know what they say about unwanted kindness being a nuisance. Besides, you never even get a real conversation out of that mysterious transfer student.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, I can't just ignore someone when he's the only one looking like he's not having any fun.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, I'm keepin' my mouth shut.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel. What do you see up there?」
Since there's no reply, I look in the direction Azel is gazing.
A blue sky. Wispy white clouds.
Nothing there after all.

name: Synn
message: 「It's clear out again today, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. You like clear skies, Azel.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's true, just looking at a clear sky makes you feel like your soul is being cleansed.」

name: Synn
message: 「I understand wanting to stare at it forever.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, though. Don't you ever feel like sharing that kind of moving feeling with someone?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Azel, what do you like about the blue sky?」

name: Synn
message: 「Like I said earlier, I love how endlessly clear it is, like it purifies you right down to the bottom of your heart」

name: Synn
message: 「Or is there something over there?」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel? Huh?」

name: Paqy
message: 「If you're looking for the mysterious transfer student, he took off ages ago」

name: Synn
message: 「Say what!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
Whose is that?
I'm the only one here, though? Wait, oh yeah.

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy. When did you go and buy a cell phone?」

name: Paqy
message: 「My wallet is one in body and soul with the Demon Lord's. There's no way I could buy one」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, since when did my wallet become one with yours!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Listen up. Soba forced that on you earlier, remember? To stay in touch」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah」
I pulled out the cell phone I had shoved into my pocket.

name: Synn
message: 「Hello」

name: Misa
message: 「What are you doing!」

name: Synn
message: 「M-My head...」
Getting yelled at right in my ear... makes my head spin.

name: Misa
message: 「There's tons of stuff we have to process! Hurry up and get back here!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry. I finished what I needed to do, so I'm heading back right now」
Alrighty then, time to work, time to work!
